pages.text: $(bold)Inverted Spear of Heaven$()$(br2)A legendary cursed tool (uses vanilla weapon logic — not a Tinkers' tool), purchased from $(bold)Mo Mo (Weapon Merchant)$(): the first two cursed-tool shelf slots of his daily stock randomly refresh between the Inverted Spear of Heaven / Prison Realm, for $(bold)10–20 Ghroth Remains$() (obtained by mining Ghroth Ore at the top of the Nether).$(li)base damage $(bold)24$(), attack speed the same as a sword$(li)$(bold)infinite durability$() — never breaks$(li)$(bold)undead bonus +6$(): deals 6 extra damage when hitting undead such as zombies / skeletons$(li)accepts $(bold)sword enchantments$() (Sharpness, Fire Aspect, etc.)

$(bold)Domain Destruction$(): while holding it, right-click a $(bold)Domain Boundary block$() to destroy that domain directly; if the domain is in the middle of a $(bold)domain clash$(), both domains $(bold)collapse at the same time$() and enter Technique Burnout (exempt in Creative mode). When a domain is destroyed, each boundary block has a $(bold)1/1000$() chance to drop a $(l:item_boundary_fragment)Boundary Fragment$().$(br2)$(bold)Ignores Limitless$(): the Inverted Spear of Heaven bypasses the defenses of "$(l:wuliang_wuxian)Infinity$()" and deals damage directly.$(br2)$(bold)Dispels shikigami$(): attacking a shikigami already on the field $(bold)removes it outright$() (interrupting the shikigami summoning).$(br2)$(bold)Technique interruption$():$(li)right-clicking a $(bold)shikigami / puppet / Black Bird$() → instantly kills that summon$(li)right-clicking a $(bold)Sweet Berry bush of the Plant Manipulation technique$() → immediately clears that root field (stops the follow-up slow / damage and restores the blocks)$(li)attacking / right-clicking a $(bold)player who is casting a technique$() → interrupts their Black Bird, puppet and plant (charge + root field), the charging of Furnace: Open / Blue, an active Infinity, a domain, and the Projection freeze penalty, and kills the shikigami on the field$(li)every interruption emits $(bold)dark-red particles$() (soot + crimson spores)

pages.title: Recipe
pages.text: The $(bold)Inverted Spear of Heaven$() is made with the $(l:curse_craft)Curse Crafting Ritual$() (the same recipe is visible in JEI):$(br2)$(bold)Core slot$() (the lantern directly above the ore):$(li)1 × Jacob's Ladder $(bold)Modifier Crystal$()$(br2)$(bold)Material slots$() (the other 8 lanterns):$(li)1 × Iron Ingot$(li)1 × Netherite Ingot$(li)1 × Stick$(li)1 × Soul Torch$(li)1 × String$(li)1 × Yellow King's Lingering Wind$(li)1 × Broken Durandal Blade$(br2)$(bold)Curse cost$(): $(bold)11500$() (the ritual drains 10 per tick, so about 58 seconds)$(br2)⚠ The core must be the crystal that actually $(bold)carries Jacob's Ladder$() (the Momo merchant sells two random technique crystals) — a blank crystal or a different technique will not match. The material count must be $(bold)exact$() (7 here); one extra item and the ritual will not start.
